versions.content: When all NodeChannels of a channel are configured for deferred online state ( J1939NmNode StartUpDelay enabled), the J1939 Network Management module shall report the state change of these NodeChannels to the ‘Offline’ state immediately to the NM Interface via Nm_StateChangeNotification(NM_STATE_OFFLINE).
